facts.activity_file: assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: regulator directive concerning danger tagging at ZV-7210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on ZV-7210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. ZV-7210 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 27 August 2007 a regulatory notice was issued concerning ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal following commissioning of replacement equipment.
